newsitem.title: USA: Viacom sees stronger Blockbuster sales.
newsitem.headline: Viacom sees stronger Blockbuster sales.

text.p: Viacom Inc Chairman Sumner Redstone said Monday the company's Blockbuster unit has posted some higher same-store sales in recent weeks.
"We've had some up comps in the last few weeks," over a year ago, Redstone told reporters after an address sponsored by the American Stock Exchange here. He did not elaborate.
A spokesman said weekly sales continued to be affected by the strength of the videos being released.
Redstone reiterated that second-quarter sales for the video renter were "soft," but "We're beginning to see some light.

Redstone said that John Antioco Monday began his new job as chairman of Blockbuster, although he has been sitting in on Blockbuster meetings for several weeks. Redstone said he would meet with Antioco on Tuesday. Viacom announced his appointment on June 3.
In answer to a question, Redstone said Viacom continued talks with Seagram Co Ltd over their dispute on the joint venture USA Networks cable business.

A Delaware judge has ordered them to resolve their differences and come up with a plan on ownership of the unit, which includes USA Network and the Sci-Fi science fiction cable channel. He declined to characterize the talks.
A Viacom spokesman said the company submitted a report Monday on the status of the talks. The judge in May ordered the two companies to discontinue their venture.
